cc:Work.dc:title: f07_confirmation
cc:Work.dc:description: Two panels show all twelve numbered time blocks. Lines connect cases within each block. The 32B crossing effects consistently favor LOCAL, while the primary noncrossing interval spans zero. The separately clocked 8B target-only panel retains both conversations and their equal-weight diamond; its primary interval also spans zero. Printed intervals accompany the estimates, and the supporting ratio-of-ratios interaction is below one.
